sentences.text: Yes: at the time of reset of interest rates, REs shall provide EMI based floating rate personal loan borrowers the option to switch over to a fixed rate as per their Board approved policy.

The bank’s own policy says the Bank may, at its option, offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate at the time of reset of the floating rate, which is narrower than the in-force RBI requirement.
The documents place the RBI requirement in force on 2025-09-15 for EMI based floating rate personal loans.
